Package domain

Class DOPOSoccerException

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Throwable
java.lang.Exception
domain.DOPOSoccerException
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public class DOPOSoccerException extends Exception
Error of the game: an invalid choice, an action that cannot be done at that moment, or a file that cannot be saved or opened. Every message is a constant written in Spanish, so the interface can show it to the user as it is.
Version:
1.0
Author:
Elian Ibarra, Oscar Poveda
